Status Detail.value: Full permit under the federal emissions control law granted by the Cologne district government in September 2026. No construction start reported.
Status Detail.note: The official gazette of the Cologne district for September 2026 publishes the decision. It grants RWE Generation SE the permit applied for on 7 August 2025 to build and run a hydrogen-ready gas and steam turbine plant at Weisweiler. The plant's fuel heat input is at most 1500 MW thermal, which is not electric capacity. The permit includes a 127 metre chimney and approval to clear forest. The permit lapses if building does not start within two years of becoming final. A permit alone does not make a unit under construction, so the status stays pre-construction.
